title: Ordering-by-dispersion as a formal corpus law (per-surah similar-pair adjacency-depletion)
similar_pair_def: root-Jaccard >= 0.8 OR char-edit <= 5; substantive verses (>= 3 tokens)
adjacency_def: canonical position-difference == 1 (strict); near-adjacent <= 2 reported as V4

H1_corpus_dispersion.statistic: A_total = sum over surahs of #similar-pairs adjacent (|pos diff|=1)
H1_corpus_dispersion.direction_locked: observed < null (similar-pairs LESS adjacent than chance = dispersion)

H2_named_set_concentration.statistic: Delta = mean depletion(named eligible) - mean depletion(other eligible)
